title: Null-controllable data for cascade heat equations: almost sharp spectral spaces and modal critical times
summary: We study one-dimensional cascades of heat equations controlled through their last component. For a fixed time $T>0$, we consider the Hilbert space $\mathcal{C}_T$ of all initial data that can be steered exactly to zero at time $T$, endowed with the norm of the minimal $L^2$ control. This space can be strongly anisotropic: in explicit examples, it is incomparable with every isotropic spectral Sobolev or sub-Gaussian Gevrey scale associated with an adapted basis. For two equations, under the block Fattorini--Hautus condition, we give an almost sharp spectral description of $\mathcal{C}_T$.…
